selection: First 100 examples retained by full source scan; not a random sample and not every regression
mechanism: Collector fences last source timestamp per token for book/price_change updates, then uses last processed message timestamp as BOOK envelope. last_trade_price and book events therefore share an envelope stream with different source timing; envelope regressions are not equivalent to per-token book regressions.
scope: All 744 envelope regressions and 0 side/BTC/availability regressions remain in final evidence. The sample supports message-type mixing; no universal cause claim and no automatic quality waiver.
